normalization: diameter 1; Lassak universal lens L=B_r(0) intersect B_1(c), c=r e_6

frozen_template.name: LASSAK_R6_ATOM_COARSENING_TEMPLATE
parameters: any horizontal O(5) rotation fixing e_6
arbitrary deterministic tie-breaking on orthant boundaries
atoms: 32 sector atoms D_sigma=L intersect {x_6<=h} intersect the 5-dimensional sign orthant sigma
frozen_template.allowed_repartitioning: coarsen only by unions of whole atoms; no atom may be split or have a wall redrawn

atom_diameter_certificate.sector: diam(D_sigma)^2 <= 2 r^2 + 2 h ell < 2 r^2 + 2 r ell = 1

cap_vs_sector.location: c is in the cap; a_sigma is a strict-interior horizontal orthant point on both lens spheres and belongs to the sector

sector_vs_sector.construction: for distinct sigma,tau choose j with sigma_j=-tau_j; take u_j=3 sigma_j/sqrt(13), u_i=sigma_i/sqrt(13) for i!=j, and v analogously from tau
sector_vs_sector.witnesses: a=rho u-ell e_6, b=rho v-ell e_6
sector_vs_sector.boundary_guard: all five horizontal coordinates of u and v are nonzero, so the witnesses lie strictly inside their sign orthants

theorem: Every strict-diameter partition obtained only by coarsening the 33 frozen Lassak atoms requires all 33 atoms. Hence this explicit template cannot achieve 32 parts.
scope_guards: This is not a lower bound b(6)>=33.
It does not rule out a 32-part construction that splits an atom, moves or redraws walls, truncates the lens, changes the apex, or otherwise leaves the frozen template.
It leaves the external Euclidean status 7<=b(6)<=33 unchanged.
The minimal structural escape is to split/repartition at least one original atom or introduce new geometry.

auxiliary_subtemplate_obstruction.name: CENTER_FIXED_UNTRUNCATED_R6_HYPERCUBE_FACET_CONES
auxiliary_subtemplate_obstruction.statement: For every O(6) rotation of the 64 cube-vertex ray directions, at least one of the 12 center-apex facet cones contains two lens boundary points at squared distance 10/7>1.
proof_kernel: choose coordinate j where |(Q^T e_6)_j| is maximal
sign-balance the remaining five coordinates so their signed sum has absolute value at most the maximum
two cube vertices with common j sign and all other signs opposite then both have nonnegative axial ray component
both hit the r-sphere before the unit sphere, giving squared distance 2*(3/7)*(1+2/3)=10/7
auxiliary_subtemplate_obstruction.scope_guard: This blocks only the center-fixed, untruncated facet-cone port; it does not block the full R4-style scheme with truncation and movable apex.
